newsitem.title: USA: Provident Bancorp lowers net forecast.
newsitem.headline: Provident Bancorp lowers net forecast.

text.p: Provident Bancorp Inc said Thursday net income for the third quarter 1996 will to be $17 million, down from the $22 million expected because of a special assessment.

The company announced the one-time assessment payable on Savings Association Insurance Fund deposits as of March 31, 1995, which was included in the Department of Defense Appropriations Act signed into law on September 30, 1996, will be about $5 million for Provident on an after tax basis. This special assessment will be recognized as a third quarter 1996 expense.

On September 26 it said it expected net income for the third quarter of 1996 to be about $22 million. Taking into account the special SAIF assessment, Provident now expects net income to be approximately $17 million for the third quarter period.
